Earn points when customers buy (pasted from Word).

## Business rules

**Rule 1:** Customers earn 1 point for every whole euro they spend.
_Why:_ Loyalty policy, March 2026 (marketing).
_Example:_ When a customer pays 24.80 euros, then they earn 24 points.
_Owner:_ Loyalty product owner
_Status:_ approved

**Rule 2:** Gift card purchases never earn points.

- When the basket holds only a gift card, then no points are earned.
- When a gift card is bought with a normal item, then only the normal item earns points.

_Status:_ draft

**Rule 3 -** Points expire 12 months after they are earned.
_Status:_ approved

**Rule 4:** Points can't pay for delivery.
_Status :_ Approved
